description: Finish a Brain document file upload after the file was PUT to the upload_url from aidelly_create_brain_document_upload_url: extracts the text, adds the document and indexes it for aidelly_search_brain. Optional title, description, document_type and tags. Each upload_id becomes one document and expires after 2 hours. Hidden from browser-sandboxed chat clients. Requires workspace settings permission. Retry-safe with the same idempotency_key.
